facts: Every applicant needs an e-District One Time Registration. Name, date of birth and Aadhaar must exactly match Aadhaar.
Applying for someone else needs that person's own e-District registration.
An OTP goes to the registered mobile. The Akshaya operator will phone the applicant to get it.
The ration card is not uploaded. The operator enters the number and e-District verifies it.
Document uploads: maximum 100 KB per page, 10 pages per file.
Fees are not confirmed. The Akshaya centre will tell the fee.
